import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/app/store/useAuthStore';
import { normalizeRole } from '@/components/auth/ProtectedRoute';
import type { UserRole } from '@/app/store/useUIStore';
import { Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

import GisNavbar from '../components/GisNavbar';
import SipasMap3D from '../components/SipasMap3D';
import GisSidebar from '../components/GisSidebar';
import PanelOrchestrator from '../components/PanelOrchestrator';
import MapHUD from '../components/MapHUD';
import ZoningHorizontalLegend from '../components/ZoningHorizontalLegend';

export default function GISPage() {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const activeRole = user ? (normalizeRole(user.role, user.username) as UserRole) : 'Super Admin';

  const isExecutive = activeRole === 'Kepala Bidang' || activeRole === 'Super Admin' || activeRole === 'Tim Teknis';

  useEffect(() => {
    toast.info(`Kanvas Geospasial GEOSIPAS aktif sebagai: ${activeRole}`, {
      id: 'gis-active-role-toast'
    });
  }, [activeRole]);

  return (
    <main className="relative h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-slate-50 font-sans text-slate-800 antialiased select-none">

      {}
      <SipasMap3D />

      {}
      <GisNavbar />

      {}
      <GisSidebar />

      {}
      <PanelOrchestrator />

      {}
      {isExecutive && (
        <div className="absolute top-[88px] right-6 z-30">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toast.success("AI Site Plan Reviewer diaktifkan di panel.")}
            className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 bg-slate-900 border border-teal-500 text-teal-400 hover:bg-teal-600 hover:text-white transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(13,148,136,0.4)] rounded-none outline-none group active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            title="AI Site Plan Reviewer"
          >
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-teal-400/20 animate-ping opacity-30" />
            <Sparkles size={20} className="relative z-10" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      <MapHUD />
      <ZoningHorizontalLegend />

    </main>
  );
}

--- FILE: src\features\pkkpr\api\pkkprApi.ts ---

import { API_BASE_URL as BASE_URL } from '@/config';
import type {
  PKKPRListItem,
  PKKPRDetail,
  SubmitPKKPRPayload,
  EvaluateSpatialPayload,
  RecordFPRPayload,
  DraftSKPayload
} from '../types/pkkpr.types';

const PKKPR_BASE = `${BASE_URL}/api/pkkpr`;

function getAuthHeaders(): HeadersInit {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  return {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {})
  };
}

export const pkkprApi = {

  async submit(payload: SubmitPKKPRPayload): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/submit`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal mengajukan permohonan PKKPR.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async list(statusFilter?: string): Promise<PKKPRListItem[]> {
    const url = statusFilter
      ? `${PKKPR_BASE}/list?status_filter=${encodeURIComponent(statusFilter)}`
      : `${PKKPR_BASE}/list`;
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal memuat daftar permohonan PKKPR.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async getMyApprovedSK(): Promise<PKKPRListItem[]> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/my-approved-sk`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal memuat SK PKKPR aktif.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async getDetail(id: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || `Gagal memuat detail permohonan ${id}.`);
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async claimAdmin(id: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/claim-admin`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal mengunci berkas administrasi.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async releaseAdmin(id: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/release-admin`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal melepaskan kunci berkas.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async verifyAdmin(id: string, action: 'APPROVE' | 'REJECT', notes?: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/verify-admin`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ action, notes })
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal memverifikasi dokumen.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async claimTechnical(id: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/claim-technical`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal mengunci berkas teknis.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async releaseTechnical(id: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/release-technical`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal melepaskan kunci teknis.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async evaluateSpatial(id: string, payload: EvaluateSpatialPayload): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/evaluate-spatial`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal menyimpan hasil kajian spasial.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async recordFPR(id: string, payload: RecordFPRPayload): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/record-fpr`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal mencatat notula sidang FPR.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async draftSK(id: string, payload: DraftSKPayload): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/draft-sk`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal merumuskan draf SK.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async signKadisTTE(id: string, final_sk_number: string, passphrase_pin: string): Promise<PKKPRDetail> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${id}/sign-tte`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ final_sk_number, passphrase_pin })
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal menandatangani TTE SK.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async validateContainment(pkkpr_id: string, siteplan_geometry: any): Promise<{
    is_covered: boolean;
    area_outside_m2: number;
    message: string;
  }> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/validate-siteplan-containment`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ pkkpr_id, siteplan_geometry })
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal memvalidasi kepatuhan spasial.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async getQuotaSummary(pkkpr_id: string): Promise<import('../types/pkkpr.types').PKKPRQuotaSummary> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${pkkpr_id}/quota-summary`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: getAuthHeaders()
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal memuat ringkasan kuota PKKPR.');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async validatePhasedSitePlan(
    payload: import('../types/pkkpr.types').ValidatePhasedSitePlanPayload
  ): Promise<import('../types/pkkpr.types').ValidatePhasedSitePlanResponse> {
    const res = await fetch(`${PKKPR_BASE}/${payload.pkkpr_id}/validate-phased-siteplan`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Gagal melakukan validasi site plan bertahap.');
    }
    return res.json();
  }
};

--- FILE: src\features\pkkpr\components\PKKPRQuotaCard.tsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Building2,
  Layers,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  MapPin,
  FileText,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { PKKPRQuotaSummary } from '../types/pkkpr.types';
import { pkkprApi } from '../api/pkkprApi';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface PKKPRQuotaCardProps {
  summary?: PKKPRQuotaSummary | null;
  pkkprId?: string;
  currentProposedAreaM2?: number;
  proposedArea?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export const PKKPRQuotaCard: React.FC<PKKPRQuotaCardProps> = ({
  summary: propSummary,
  pkkprId,
  currentProposedAreaM2,
  proposedArea,
  className
}) => {
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const effectiveProposedArea = currentProposedAreaM2 ?? proposedArea ?? 0;

  const { data: fetchedSummary, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['pkkpr-quota-summary', pkkprId],
    queryFn: () => pkkprApi.getQuotaSummary(pkkprId!),
    enabled: !!pkkprId && !propSummary,
    staleTime: 60000,
  });

  const summary = propSummary || fetchedSummary;

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={cn("p-4 border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/30 flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-emerald-800", className)}>
        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-emerald-600" />
        <span>Memuat data silsilah kuota alokasi lahan PKKPR...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!summary) return null;

  const totalArea = summary.total_approved_area_m2;
  const usedArea = summary.used_area_m2;
  const remainingArea = summary.remaining_area_m2;
  const isOverQuota = effectiveProposedArea > remainingArea;
  const projectedRemaining = Math.max(0, remainingArea - effectiveProposedArea);
  const utilizationPct = summary.utilization_percent;

  const getProgressColor = (pct: number) => {
    if (pct >= 90) return 'bg-rose-500';
    if (pct >= 75) return 'bg-amber-500';
    return 'bg-emerald-500';
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn(
      "rounded-xl border border-emerald-200/90 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50/50 via-white to-slate-50/60 p-5 shadow-sm transition-all duration-300",
      isOverQuota && "border-rose-300 from-rose-50/50",
      className
    )}>
      {}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 pb-4 border-b border-emerald-100">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm shrink-0">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-emerald-800 uppercase bg-emerald-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                SK PKKPR Terpilih (Kabupaten Bogor)
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                Terbit: {summary.sk_issued_date || 'Sah & Terverifikasi'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>{summary.sk_number || summary.submission_no}</span>
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
              Pemohon: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{summary.applicant_name}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-center">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-emerald-200">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {summary.status}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="my-4 space-y-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold">
          <span className="text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
            Pemanfaatan Kuota Tanah Bertahap (Perbup Bogor No. 4/2025 Pasal 3)
          </span>
          <span className="text-slate-900 font-bold">
            {utilizationPct.toFixed(1)}% Terpakai
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full bg-slate-200/80 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden p-0.5">
          <div
            className={cn("h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ease-out", getProgressColor(utilizationPct))}
            style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, utilizationPct)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 my-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider block">
            Alokasi SK Induk
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
            {totalArea.toLocaleString('id-ID')} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">m²</span>
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider block">
            Terpakai Tahap Lalu
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
            {usedArea.toLocaleString('id-ID')} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">m²</span>
          </p>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">
            {summary.siteplans_count} Tahap Terdaftar
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase tracking-wider block">
            Sisa Kuota Tersedia
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-emerald-700 mt-0.5">
            {remainingArea.toLocaleString('id-ID')} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-emerald-600">m²</span>
          </p>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600/80 block mt-0.5">
            Maks. untuk tahap ini
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={cn(
          "p-3 rounded-lg border shadow-xs transition-colors",
          isOverQuota
            ? "bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-900"
            : "bg-blue-50/70 border-blue-200 text-blue-900"
        )}>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider block opacity-80">
            Usulan Tahap Ini
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-extrabold mt-0.5">
            {effectiveProposedArea > 0 ? effectiveProposedArea.toLocaleString('id-ID') : '0'}{' '}
            <span className="text-xs font-normal opacity-70">m²</span>
          </p>
          <span className="text-[10px] opacity-80 block mt-0.5">
            {isOverQuota ? '❌ Melebihi Kuota!' : `Sisa nanti: ${projectedRemaining.toLocaleString('id-ID')} m²`}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      {isOverQuota && (
        <div className="my-3 p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 text-rose-800 text-xs animate-shake">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold">Peringatan Kuota Melampaui Izin:</span>
            <p className="mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
              Luas yang Anda ajukan pada tahap ini ({effectiveProposedArea.toLocaleString('id-ID')} m²) melampaui sisa kuota yang diizinkan oleh SK PKKPR ({remainingArea.toLocaleString('id-ID')} m²). Mohon sesuaikan luas tapak pada Tahap 3 (Data Lokasi) atau ajukan addendum perluasan PKKPR.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {summary.envelope && (
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            Parameter Intensitas Ruang SK Induk (Autofill Standar):
          </span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-xs">
            {summary.envelope.spatial_zone_code && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                Zonasi: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.spatial_zone_code}</strong> ({summary.envelope.spatial_zone_name || 'RDTR'})
              </span>
            )}
            {summary.envelope.approved_kdb_max != null && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                KDB Maks: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.approved_kdb_max}%</strong>
              </span>
            )}
            {summary.envelope.approved_klb_max != null && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                KLB Maks: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.approved_klb_max}</strong>
              </span>
            )}
            {summary.envelope.approved_kdh_min != null && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                KDH Min: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.approved_kdh_min}%</strong>
              </span>
            )}
            {summary.envelope.approved_gsb_min != null && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                GSB Min: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.approved_gsb_min} m</strong>
              </span>
            )}
            {summary.envelope.approved_max_floors != null && (
              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-medium text-[11px] border border-slate-200">
                Maks. Lantai: <strong className="text-slate-900">{summary.envelope.approved_max_floors} Lt</strong>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {summary.siteplans && summary.siteplans.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowHistory(!showHistory)}
            className="flex items-center justify-between w-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors py-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              Lihat Daftar {summary.siteplans.length} Site Plan Tahap Sebelumnya
            </span>
            {showHistory ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </button>

          {showHistory && (
            <div className="mt-2.5 space-y-1.5 bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 pb-1.5 border-b border-slate-100 grid grid-cols-12 gap-2">
                <span className="col-span-5">Nama Klaster / Tahap</span>
                <span className="col-span-3 text-right">Luas Lahan</span>
                <span className="col-span-4 text-right">Status Berkas</span>
              </div>
              {summary.siteplans.map((sp) => (
                <div key={sp.id_permohonan} className="text-xs text-slate-600 grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 py-1 border-b border-slate-50 last:border-0 items-center">
                  <div className="col-span-5 font-medium truncate text-slate-800" title={sp.housing_name || sp.submission_no}>
                    {sp.housing_name || sp.submission_no}
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    {sp.land_area.toLocaleString('id-ID')} m²
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-4 text-right">
                    <span className="inline-block text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                      {sp.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

--- FILE: src\features\pkkpr\components\PKKPRStatusBadge.tsx ---
import React from 'react';
import type { PKKPRStatus } from '../types/pkkpr.types';

interface Props {
  status: PKKPRStatus;
  className?: string;
}

export const PKKPRStatusBadge: React.FC<Props> = ({ status, className = '' }) => {
  const getBadgeStyle = () => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'DRAFT':
        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-300';
      case 'PENGAJUAN_BERKAS':
        return 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200';
      case 'VERIFIKASI_ADMINISTRASI':
        return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200';
      case 'KAJIAN_TEKNIS_SPASIAL':
        return 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200';
      case 'SIDANG_FPR':
        return 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200';
      case 'MENUNGGU_REKOMENDASI_KABID':
        return 'bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-700 border-cyan-200';
      case 'MENUNGGU_TTE_KADIS':
        return 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-300';
      case 'DISETUJUI':
        return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300 font-bold';
      case 'DITOLAK':
        return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200';
      case 'TIDAK_BERLAKU':
        return 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500 border-gray-300 line-through';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-200';
    }
  };

  const getLabel = () => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'DRAFT':
        return 'Draf Pengajuan';
      case 'PENGAJUAN_BERKAS':
        return 'Menunggu Verifikasi Admin';
      case 'VERIFIKASI_ADMINISTRASI':
        return 'Sedang Diverifikasi Admin';
      case 'KAJIAN_TEKNIS_SPASIAL':
        return 'Kajian Spasial PUPR';
      case 'SIDANG_FPR':
        return 'Tahap Sidang Komite FPR';
      case 'MENUNGGU_REKOMENDASI_KABID':
        return 'Perumusan Draf SK Kabid';
      case 'MENUNGGU_TTE_KADIS':
        return 'Menunggu TTE Kadis';
      case 'DISETUJUI':
        return 'SK PKKPR Terbit (Disetujui)';
      case 'DITOLAK':
        return 'Ditolak / Revisi';
      case 'TIDAK_BERLAKU':
        return 'Tidak Berlaku';
      default:
        return status;
    }
  };

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${getBadgeStyle()} ${className}`}
    >
      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full mr-1.5 bg-current opacity-75" />
      {getLabel()}
    </span>
  );
};

--- FILE: src\features\pkkpr\pages\PKKPRCreateWizard.tsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { pkkprApi } from '../api/pkkprApi';
import type { SubmitPKKPRPayload, PKKPRCategory } from '../types/pkkpr.types';

export const PKKPRCreateWizard: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<SubmitPKKPRPayload>({
    applicant_type: 'BADAN_USAHA',
    applicant_name: '',
    applicant_nik: '',
    applicant_nib: '',
    applicant_npwp: '',
    applicant_phone: '',
    applicant_email: '',
    category: 'BERUSAHA_PENILAIAN',
    activity_description: '',
    kbli_code: '41011',
    location_address: '',
    location_village: 'Cibinong',
    location_district: 'Cibinong',
    location_city: 'Kabupaten Bogor',
    proposed_land_area_m2: 10000,
    geometry: {
      type: 'Polygon',
      coordinates: [
        [
          [106.840, -6.480],
          [106.845, -6.480],
          [106.845, -6.485],
          [106.840, -6.485],
          [106.840, -6.480]
        ]
      ]
    }
  });

  const [rawGeoJsonInput, setRawGeoJsonInput] = useState(
    JSON.stringify(formData.geometry, null, 2)
  );

  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof SubmitPKKPRPayload, value: any) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleGeoJsonChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setRawGeoJsonInput(e.target.value);
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(e.target.value);
      if (parsed.type && parsed.coordinates) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, geometry: parsed }));
        setErrorMessage(null);
      }
    } catch {

    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      if (!formData.applicant_name) {
        throw new Error('Nama pemohon / badan usaha wajib diisi.');
      }
      if (!formData.activity_description) {
        throw new Error('Deskripsi kegiatan pemanfaatan ruang wajib diisi.');
      }
      if (formData.proposed_land_area_m2 <= 0) {
        throw new Error('Luas lahan yang dimohonkan harus lebih besar dari 0 m².');
      }

      const res = await pkkprApi.submit(formData);
      navigate(`/pkkpr/${res.id}`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal mengirimkan permohonan PKKPR.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 space-y-8">
      {}
      <div>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/pkkpr')}
          className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 hover:text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1 mb-2"
        >
          ← Kembali ke Daftar PKKPR
        </button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
          Formulir Pengajuan Permohonan PKKPR
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
          Persetujuan Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang — Pemerintah Kabupaten Bogor
        </p>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 pb-4">
        {[
          { step: 1, label: 'Data Pemohon' },
          { step: 2, label: 'Kegiatan Ruang' },
          { step: 3, label: 'Lokasi & Batas Poligon' },
          { step: 4, label: 'Konfirmasi' }
        ].map((item) => (
          <div key={item.step} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${
                currentStep === item.step
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md'
                  : currentStep > item.step
                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                  : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-400'
              }`}
            >
              {currentStep > item.step ? '✓' : item.step}
            </span>
            <span
              className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                currentStep === item.step ? 'text-gray-900 font-semibold' : 'text-gray-400'
              }`}
            >
              {item.label}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg text-rose-700 text-sm">
          <strong>Perhatian: </strong> {errorMessage}
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {currentStep === 1 && (
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">
            Tahap 1: Data Identitas Pemohon
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Kategori Permohonan</label>
              <select
                value={formData.category}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('category', e.target.value as PKKPRCategory)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
              >
                <option value="BERUSAHA_PENILAIAN">Berusaha (Pelaku Usaha / Developer Properti)</option>
                <option value="NON_BERUSAHA">Non-Berusaha (Rumah Tinggal Pribadi / Fasos / Yayasan)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Tipe Pemohon</label>
              <select
                value={formData.applicant_type}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_type', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
              >
                <option value="BADAN_USAHA">Badan Usaha (PT / CV / Yayasan / Koperasi)</option>
                <option value="PERORANGAN">Perorangan</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                Nama Lengkap Pemohon / Nama Perusahaan *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.applicant_name}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_name', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Contoh: PT. Graha Selaras Properti / Bpk. Hendra Gunawan"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.applicant_nib || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_nib', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="13 digit NIB (jika berusaha)"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">NIK Pemohon / Penanggung Jawab</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.applicant_nik || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_nik', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="16 digit NIK KTP"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Nomor WhatsApp / HP Aktif</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.applicant_phone || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_phone', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="08xxxxxxxxxx"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Alamat Email Resmi</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                value={formData.applicant_email || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('applicant_email', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="email@perusahaan.com"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {currentStep === 2 && (
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">

          </h2>

              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.kbli_code || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('kbli_code', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Contoh: 41011 (Konstruksi Gedung Hunian)"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">

              </label>

                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('activity_description', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Jelaskan secara spesifik kegiatan yang akan dilakukan, misalnya: Pembangunan kawasan perumahan tapak bersubsidi dan komersial dengan total 150 unit rumah beserta fasilitas jalan, drainase, dan RTH..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />

              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                Alamat Lengkap Lokasi Kegiatan *
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={formData.location_address}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('location_address', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Jl. Raya Pemda No. 45, RT 02/RW 04..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {currentStep === 3 && (
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">
            Tahap 3: Lokasi Administratif & Koordinat Poligon Lahan
          </h2>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Kecamatan *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.location_district}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('location_district', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Cibinong / Babakan Madang..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Desa / Kelurahan *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.location_village}
                onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('location_village', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Tengah / Pakansari..."

            </div>

              value={rawGeoJsonInput}
              onChange={handleGeoJsonChange}
              placeholder="Paste GeoJSON Polygon coordinates..."

            />
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
              💡 Format standar GeoJSON Polygon dengan pasangan koordinat [Longitude, Latitude].
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {currentStep === 4 && (
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">

              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formData.applicant_name}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
              <span className="text-gray-500">Kategori:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formData.category}</span>

            <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
              <span className="text-gray-500">Lokasi Lahan:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                {formData.location_village}, {formData.location_district}, {formData.location_city}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b border-gray-200">
              <span className="text-gray-500">Luas Lahan Dimohon:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                {formData.proposed_land_area_m2.toLocaleString('id-ID')} m²
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
              <span className="text-gray-500">Uraian Kegiatan:</span>
              <span className="text-gray-800 text-right max-w-md">{formData.activity_description}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-emerald-900 space-y-1">
            <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
              <span>📜</span> Pernyataan Integritas Tata Ruang:
            </p>
            <p>

              dan tanah yang dimohonkan tidak sedang dalam sengketa hukum. Saya memahami bahwa SK PKKPR ini
              nantinya akan menjadi batas sah yang wajib dipatuhi dalam pengajuan Site Plan selanjutnya.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setCurrentStep((prev) => prev - 1)}
            className="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"
          >
            ← Kembali
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div />
        )}

        {currentStep < 4 ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (currentStep === 1 && !formData.applicant_name) {
                setErrorMessage('Mohon lengkapi nama pemohon terlebih dahulu.');
                return;
              }
              if (currentStep === 2 && !formData.activity_description) {
                setErrorMessage('Mohon lengkapi deskripsi kegiatan pemanfaatan ruang.');
                return;
              }
              setErrorMessage(null);
              setCurrentStep((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            className="px-6 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-lg shadow-sm"
          >
            Lanjutkan →
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            className="px-6 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:bg-gray-400 text-white font-semibold text-sm rounded-lg shadow-md flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            {isSubmitting ? 'Mengirim Berkas...' : 'Kirim Pengajuan PKKPR Resmi ✓'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

--- FILE: src\features\pkkpr\pages\PKKPRDetailPage.tsx ---
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { pkkprApi } from '../api/pkkprApi';
import type { PKKPRDetail } from '../types/pkkpr.types';
import { PKKPRStatusBadge } from '../components/PKKPRStatusBadge';

export const PKKPRDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<PKKPRDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);

  const [showSpatialModal, setShowSpatialModal] = useState(false);
  const [showFPRModal, setShowFPRModal] = useState(false);
  const [showDraftSKModal, setShowDraftSKModal] = useState(false);
  const [showTTEModal, setShowTTEModal] = useState(false);

  const [spatialForm, setSpatialForm] = useState({
    approved_land_area_m2: 0,
    approved_kdb_max: 60,
    approved_klb_max: 1.8,
    approved_kdh_min: 20,
    approved_gsb_min: 5,
    approved_max_floors: 3,
    spatial_zone_code: 'R-2',
    spatial_zone_name: 'Zona Perumahan Kepadatan Sedang'
  });

  const [fprForm, setFprForm] = useState({
    meeting_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    official_report_no: `BA-FPR/${new Date().getFullYear()}/001`,
    recommendation: 'DISETUJUI_SELURUHNYA' as const,
    ptp_bpn_number: 'PTP/BPN/2026/042',
    zoning_compliance_notes: 'Sesuai dengan ketentuan rencana tata ruang wilayah (RTRW) Kabupaten Bogor.',
    infrastructure_notes: 'Akses jalan utama memenuhi ROW minimal 8 meter.'
  });

  const [draftSKForm, setDraftSKForm] = useState({
    draft_sk_number: `503/PKKPR/DPMPTSP/${new Date().getFullYear()}/001`,
    kabid_notes: 'Draf SK telah diselaraskan dengan rekomendasi rapat pleno FPR.'
  });

  const [ttePin, setTtePin] = useState('123456');

  const loadDetail = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const data = await pkkprApi.getDetail(id);
      setDetail(data);
      setSpatialForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        approved_land_area_m2: data.approved_land_area_m2 || data.proposed_land_area_m2
      }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat detail permohonan PKKPR.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDetail();
  }, [id]);

  const handleClaimAdmin = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.claimAdmin(id);
      setDetail(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyAdmin = async (action: 'APPROVE' | 'REJECT') => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.verifyAdmin(id, action);
      setDetail(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClaimTechnical = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.claimTechnical(id);
      setDetail(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSpatial = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.evaluateSpatial(id, spatialForm);
      setDetail(updated);
      setShowSpatialModal(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveFPR = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.recordFPR(id, fprForm);
      setDetail(updated);
      setShowFPRModal(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveDraftSK = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const updated = await pkkprApi.draftSK(id, draftSKForm);
      setDetail(updated);
      setShowDraftSKModal(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSignTTE = async () => {
    if (!id || !detail) return;
    try {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const skNumber = detail.sk_draft?.draft_sk_number || `503/PKKPR/${new Date().getFullYear()}/${detail.submission_no.split('/').pop()}`;
      const updated = await pkkprApi.signKadisTTE(id, skNumber, ttePin);
      setDetail(updated);
      setShowTTEModal(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <div className="inline-block animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-4 border-emerald-500 border-t-transparent mb-3" />
        <p className="text-sm">Memuat berkas permohonan PKKPR...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !detail) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center text-rose-600 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <p className="font-semibold">{error || 'Data permohonan tidak ditemukan.'}</p>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/pkkpr')} className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm">
          Kembali ke Daftar
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-6">
      {}
      <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/pkkpr')}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 hover:text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1 mb-1"
          >
            ← Kembali ke Antrean PKKPR
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{detail.submission_no}</h1>
            <PKKPRStatusBadge status={detail.status} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
            Diajukan oleh <strong className="text-gray-700">{detail.applicant_name}</strong> pada{' '}
            {new Date(detail.created_at).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
              day: 'numeric',
              month: 'long',
              year: 'numeric'
            })}
          </p>
        </div>

        {}
        {detail.status === 'DISETUJUI' && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate('/submissions/create', { state: { preselected_pkkpr_id: detail.id } })}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-transform active:scale-95"
            >
              <span>📐</span> Ajukan Pengesahan Site Plan
            </button>
            <span className="text-xs text-emerald-800 font-mono">
              SK Terbit: {detail.sk_number}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>📍</span> Informasi Lokasi & Rencana Kegiatan
            </h2>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase font-medium">Kategori Permohonan</p>
                <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mt-0.5">
                  {detail.category === 'NON_BERUSAHA' ? 'Non-Berusaha' : 'Berusaha (Penilaian FPR)'}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase font-medium">Kode KBLI Usaha</p>
                <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mt-0.5 font-mono">{detail.kbli_code || '-'}</p>
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase font-medium">Uraian Pemanfaatan Ruang</p>
                <p className="text-gray-700 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-100">
                  {detail.activity_description}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase font-medium">Desa / Kecamatan</p>
                <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mt-0.5">

            </h2>

              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Belum ada risalah sidang komite FPR yang tercatat.</p>

                      <span className="font-bold text-purple-900">Berita Acara: {rev.official_report_no}</span>
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-purple-200 text-purple-800 rounded text-xs font-semibold">
                        {rev.recommendation}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">
                      <strong>Tanggal Sidang: </strong> {rev.meeting_date} | <strong>PTP BPN: </strong> {rev.ptp_bpn_number || '-'}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-700 bg-white p-2.5 rounded border border-purple-100">
                      <strong>Catatan Kesesuaian Tata Ruang: </strong> {rev.zoning_compliance_notes}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}

        {}

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>⚙️</span> Panel Otoritas Petugas
            </h2>

            {}
            {detail.status === 'PENGAJUAN_BERKAS' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Berkas baru masuk. Silakan kunci berkas untuk memulai verifikasi formal.</p>
                <button
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  onClick={handleClaimAdmin}
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-medium text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                >
                  🔒 Kunci Berkas Administrasi (Claim)
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {detail.status === 'VERIFIKASI_ADMINISTRASI' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 font-medium">Sedang dalam peninjauan administrasi.</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    onClick={() => handleVerifyAdmin('APPROVE')}

                  >
                    ✓ Loloskan Formal
                  </button>
                  <button
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    onClick={() => handleVerifyAdmin('REJECT')}
                    className="flex-1 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                  >
                    ✕ Tolak Berkas
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {}
            {detail.status === 'KAJIAN_TEKNIS_SPASIAL' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700 font-medium">Tahap analisis spasial GIS oleh Tim Teknis PUPR.</p>
                {!detail.technical_lock_id ? (
                  <button
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    onClick={handleClaimTechnical}
                    className="w-full py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-medium text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                  >
                    🔒 Kunci Berkas Teknis (Claim)
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    onClick={() => setShowSpatialModal(true)}
                    className="w-full py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                  >
                    📐 Input Hasil Kajian Spasial & Parameter Ruang
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {}
            {detail.status === 'SIDANG_FPR' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-purple-700 font-medium">Kajian spasial selesai. Berkas siap dibahas dalam Sidang Komite FPR.</p>
                <button
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  onClick={() => setShowFPRModal(true)}
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                >
                  📝 Catat Notula Sidang & Rekomendasi FPR
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {}
            {detail.status === 'MENUNGGU_REKOMENDASI_KABID' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-cyan-800 font-medium">Rekomendasi FPR selesai. Kabid merumuskan draf SK.</p>
                <button
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  onClick={() => setShowDraftSKModal(true)}
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-cyan-700 hover:bg-cyan-800 text-white font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg shadow-sm"
                >
                  ✍️ Rumuskan & Paraf Draf SK (Kabid)
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {}
            {detail.status === 'MENUNGGU_TTE_KADIS' && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-yellow-800 font-medium">Draf SK telah diparaf Kabid. Menunggu TTE resmi Kadis DPMPTSP.</p>
                <button
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                  onClick={() => setShowTTEModal(true)}
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-lg shadow-md"
                >
                  🔏 Tandatangani TTE BSrE (Kepala Dinas)
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {detail.status === 'DISETUJUI' && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-emerald-800 space-y-1">
                <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>✓</span> SK PKKPR Resmi Aktif
                </p>
                <p>Nomor: {detail.sk_number}</p>
                <p>QR Integritas: {detail.qr_code_hash?.substring(0, 16)}...</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      {showSpatialModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">
              Kajian Spasial & Parameter Tata Ruang
            </h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="col-span-2">
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Luas Lahan Disetujui (m²)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={spatialForm.approved_land_area_m2}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, approved_land_area_m2: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">KDB Maksimal (%)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={spatialForm.approved_kdb_max}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, approved_kdb_max: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">KLB Maksimal</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.1"
                  value={spatialForm.approved_klb_max}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, approved_klb_max: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">KDH Minimal (%)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={spatialForm.approved_kdh_min}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, approved_kdh_min: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">GSB Minimal (meter)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={spatialForm.approved_gsb_min}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, approved_gsb_min: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="col-span-2">
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Kode & Nama Zona RDTR</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={spatialForm.spatial_zone_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setSpatialForm({ ...spatialForm, spatial_zone_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t">
              <button onClick={() => setShowSpatialModal(false)} className="px-4 py-2 border rounded text-xs">
                Batal
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleSaveSpatial} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-semibold">
                Simpan & Teruskan ke Sidang FPR
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {showFPRModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">
              Risalah & Notula Sidang Komite Forum Penataan Ruang (FPR)
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Nomor Berita Acara Rapat FPR</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={fprForm.official_report_no}
                  onChange={(e) => setFprForm({ ...fprForm, official_report_no: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Rekomendasi Akhir Sidang FPR</label>
                <select
                  value={fprForm.recommendation}
                  onChange={(e) => setFprForm({ ...fprForm, recommendation: e.target.value as any })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="DISETUJUI_SELURUHNYA">Disetujui Seluruhnya</option>
                  <option value="DISETUJUI_SEBAGIAN">Disetujui Sebagian</option>
                  <option value="DITOLAK">Ditolak / Tidak Sesuai Tata Ruang</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Pertimbangan Teknis Pertanahan (PTP BPN)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={fprForm.ptp_bpn_number}
                  onChange={(e) => setFprForm({ ...fprForm, ptp_bpn_number: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Catatan Kesesuaian Tata Ruang</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={fprForm.zoning_compliance_notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setFprForm({ ...fprForm, zoning_compliance_notes: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t">
              <button onClick={() => setShowFPRModal(false)} className="px-4 py-2 border rounded text-xs">
                Batal
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleSaveFPR} className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-semibold">
                Simpan Hasil Sidang FPR
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {}
      {showDraftSKModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 border-b pb-2">
              Perumusan Draf Surat Keputusan (Kabid)
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Nomor Draf SK PKKPR</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={draftSKForm.draft_sk_number}
                  onChange={(e) => setDraftSKForm({ ...draftSKForm, draft_sk_number: e.target.value })}

                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-medium mb-1">Catatan Tambahan Kabid</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { pkkprApi } from '../api/pkkprApi';
import type { PKKPRListItem } from '../types/pkkpr.types';
import { PKKPRStatusBadge } from '../components/PKKPRStatusBadge';

export const PKKPRListPage: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<PKKPRListItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const data = await pkkprApi.list(statusFilter || undefined);
      setItems(data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat daftar permohonan PKKPR.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [statusFilter]);

  const filteredItems = items.filter((item) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      item.applicant_name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.submission_no.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      (item.sk_number && item.sk_number.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())) ||
      item.location_village.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    return matchesSearch;
  });

  const totalCount = items.length;
  const approvedCount = items.filter((i) => i.status === 'DISETUJUI').length;
  const inProgressCount = items.filter((i) => !['DISETUJUI', 'DITOLAK', 'DRAFT'].includes(i.status)).length;
  const rejectedCount = items.filter((i) => i.status === 'DITOLAK').length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
      {}
      <div className="sm:flex sm:items-center sm:justify-between border-b border-gray-200 pb-5">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 rounded-lg text-lg">🏛️</span>
            Pelayanan PKKPR Kabupaten Bogor
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
            Persetujuan Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang (Prasyarat Utama Pengesahan Site Plan & PBG)
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 sm:mt-0 flex gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/pkkpr/create')}
            className="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-transparent rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="mr-2 text-base">+</span> Buat Pengajuan PKKPR Baru
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Total Permohonan</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">{totalCount}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600 font-bold">
            Σ
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Sedang Diproses Dinas</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600 mt-1">{inProgressCount}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-600 font-bold">
            ⏳
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">SK Terbit (Disetujui)</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600 mt-1">{approvedCount}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 font-bold">
            ✓
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Perlu Perbaikan / Ditolak</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-rose-600 mt-1">{rejectedCount}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-600 font-bold">
            ✕
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-center justify-between">
        <div className="w-full sm:w-96 relative">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Cari nama pemohon, no registrasi, lokasi desa..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-emerald-500"
          />
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400">🔍</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-emerald-500 bg-white"
          >
            <option value="">Semua Status Berkas</option>
            <option value="PENGAJUAN_BERKAS">Pengajuan Berkas</option>
            <option value="VERIFIKASI_ADMINISTRASI">Verifikasi Administrasi</option>
            <option value="KAJIAN_TEKNIS_SPASIAL">Kajian Spasial PUPR</option>
            <option value="SIDANG_FPR">Sidang FPR</option>
            <option value="MENUNGGU_REKOMENDASI_KABID">Draf SK Kabid</option>
            <option value="MENUNGGU_TTE_KADIS">Menunggu TTE Kadis</option>
            <option value="DISETUJUI">SK Terbit (Disetujui)</option>
            <option value="DITOLAK">Ditolak / Revisi</option>
          </select>

          <button
            onClick={loadData}
            title="Refresh Data"
            className="px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"
          >
            🔄
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {}
      <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500">
            <div className="inline-block animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-4 border-emerald-500 border-t-transparent mb-3" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Memuat data permohonan PKKPR...</p>
          </div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-rose-600">
            <p className="font-medium">{error}</p>
            <button onClick={loadData} className="mt-3 text-sm text-emerald-600 underline">
              Coba Muat Ulang
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500">
            <p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-700">Tidak ada permohonan PKKPR yang ditemukan.</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-1">Silakan sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau buat pengajuan baru.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 text-left text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5">No. Registrasi & Tanggal</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5">Pemohon & Kategori</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5">Lokasi & Luas Tanah</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5">Status Permohonan</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5">Petugas Pengunci</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-3.5 text-right">Aksi</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-gray-800">
                {filteredItems.map((item) => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50/75 transition-colors">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{item.submission_no}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                        {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
                          day: 'numeric',
                          month: 'short',
                          year: 'numeric'
                        })}
                      </div>
                      {item.sk_number && (
                        <div className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-700 mt-1 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded inline-block">
                          SK: {item.sk_number}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">{item.applicant_name}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                        {item.category === 'NON_BERUSAHA' ? 'Non-Berusaha (Sosial/Pribadi)' : 'Berusaha (Penilaian FPR)'}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                        {item.location_village}, {item.location_district}

                      </div>

                    <td className="px-6 py-4">

export type PKKPRStatus =
  | 'DRAFT'
  | 'PENGAJUAN_BERKAS'
  | 'VERIFIKASI_ADMINISTRASI'
  | 'KAJIAN_TEKNIS_SPASIAL'
  | 'SIDANG_FPR'
  | 'MENUNGGU_REKOMENDASI_KABID'
  | 'MENUNGGU_TTE_KADIS'
  | 'DISETUJUI'
  | 'DITOLAK'
  | 'TIDAK_BERLAKU';

  | 'NON_BERUSAHA'

  | 'BERUSAHA_OTOMATIS';

export type FPRRecommendation =

  siteplan_geometry?: any;
  exclude_permohonan_id?: string;
}

export interface ValidatePhasedSitePlanResponse {
  is_valid: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  details?: {
    error_type?: string;
    total_approved_area_m2?: number;
    current_used_area_m2?: number;
    remaining_quota_m2?: number;
    requested_area_m2?: number;
    area_outside_m2?: number;
    conflicting_submission_no?: string;
    overlap_area_m2?: number;
    [key: string]: any;
  };
}
